description: 6 paired A/B evaluation tasks for hardware/generic/goldfish/emulator/plugin/hal/AGENTS.md across HAL Discovery, First-Pass HAL Implementation, and Seeded-Defect Code Review (4 Dev + 2 Holdout).

tasks.title: Raw Binary vs. QEMUD Registration, Wire Framing & TestConnectorRegistry Teardown
tasks.prompt: We need to add two new HAL devices under `hardware/generic/goldfish/emulator/plugin/hal/`: one using a raw 4-byte length-prefixed binary protocol and one using the legacy QEMUD text command protocol. Identify: (1) the exact `IConnectorRegistry` registration methods for each (and which legacy methods are deprecated), (2) the framing/parser utilities used in `OnReceive()` and `Send()` for each, (3) one canonical exemplar `.cc` file for each, and (4) the mandatory teardown call required when writing unit tests with `TestConnectorRegistry`.

tasks.title: Threading Context (client_loop vs. qemu_loop) & Observable Lock-Ordering
tasks.prompt: In `hardware/generic/goldfish/emulator/plugin/hal/`, explain the threading execution context of `HalDeviceFactory`, `OnConnect()`/`OnReceive()`/`OnClose()`, and `Socket()->Send()`. Specifically identify: (1) how a HAL device safely runs QEMU-thread-only operations such as `EmulatorResetCallbacks::do_unregister` or shutdown requests on close, (2) how a HAL device subscribes to `avd_universe` observables without leaking the plug or causing a lock-inversion deadlock when mutating device state/timers, and (3) the exemplar files demonstrating both patterns.

tasks.title: First-Pass Implementation of a Raw Binary ThermalSensor HAL + Unit Test
tasks.prompt: Inspect `hardware/generic/goldfish/emulator/plugin/hal/` and write the complete C++ public header (`include/goldfish/devices/thermal/thermal_sensor_device.h`), implementation (`thermal_sensor_device.cc`), `BUILD.bazel`, and unit test (`thermal_sensor_device_test.cc`) for a new `ThermalSensor` HAL (`kServiceName = "thermal"`) that bridges a 4-byte little-endian length-prefixed payload stream to a host `avd_universe` observable (`ThermalChannel::OnThermalChanged`). Do not modify files on disk; output the 4 complete file contents in your response.

tasks.title: First-Pass Implementation of a QEMUD PowerControl HAL + Reset Callback + Unit Test
tasks.prompt: Inspect `hardware/generic/goldfish/emulator/plugin/hal/` and write the complete C++ public header (`include/goldfish/devices/power/power_control_device.h`), implementation (`power_control_device.cc`), `BUILD.bazel`, and unit test (`power_control_device_test.cc`) for a QEMUD-framed `PowerControl` HAL (`kServiceName = "power"`) that parses incoming guest text commands, replies using QEMUD framing, and registers/unregisters an `EmulatorResetCallbacks` listener across its lifecycle. Do not modify files on disk; output the 4 complete file contents in your response.
